title: Your Stage Awaits: .NET Conf 2026 Community Days Kicks Off Call for Speakers
summary: Microsoft's beloved .NET Conf Community Days 2026 has officially opened its call for presenters, inviting developers globally to share their invaluable insights and expertise. This grassroots, community-driven event offers a prime opportunity to contribute to the vibrant .NET ecosystem by submitting session proposals between September 8 and October 6, 2026.
content:
The pulse of the .NET community quickens today as the much-anticipated .NET Conf 2026 Community Days officially launches its call for presenters. This isn't just another tech conference; it's a global celebration of developer ingenuity, powered entirely by the community itself. For aspiring and seasoned speakers alike, the opportunity to step onto this international stage and share hard-earned knowledge is now live.

From September 8 until October 6, 2026, developers, architects, and innovators across the globe are invited to submit their session proposals. This narrow window is your chance to showcase what you've learned, whether it's a groundbreaking application, a deep dive into a niche feature, practical tips for everyday coding, or insights into the future of the platform. The beauty of Community Days lies in its diversity, fostering an environment where real-world experiences and unique perspectives shine brightest.

Contributing as a presenter to .NET Conf Community Days offers more than just a speaking slot. It’s an unparalleled opportunity for professional growth, allowing you to establish yourself as a thought leader, network with peers, and directly impact the learning journey of countless fellow developers. Imagine the ripple effect of your insights reaching corners of the world where that specific piece of knowledge could unlock a new solution or inspire a fresh wave of innovation.

Microsoft's .NET team champions this community-led initiative, providing the platform and framework for a truly organic exchange of ideas. So, if you've been nurturing a brilliant presentation, experimenting with cutting-edge .NET features, or have a compelling story of problem-solving to tell, now is the time to finalize your pitch. Don't let this limited window slip by; seize the chance to shape the discourse and inspire the next generation of .NET development.
keyTakeaways: The call for presenters for .NET Conf 2026 Community Days is officially open.
Developers can submit their session proposals between September 8 and October 6, 2026.
This community-led event offers a global platform for sharing .NET knowledge and fostering ecosystem growth.
author: Javier Lozano, Chris Sfanos, Jon Galloway
